title: Too ungainly long to be a washcloth; more like a scarf or table runner
text:
Too ungainly long to be a washcloth; more like a scarf or table runner. This is not what I expected. There are two very, very long exfoliating washcloths in this package and a tiny silicone facial scrubber. The scrubber is good for the face but I cannot use these washcloths as intended. They are way too long and difficult to deal with. They can, however, be used as table runners or scarves with the exfoliating (colored) side facing up.

As washcloths, these get 2 stars and as scarves or table runners they get 4 stars--hence the 3-star rating.
